events.note:
Since no birth record for Piotr Celmer has been found, his birth year is estimated to be 1761, using C2209 as reference. The same citation also confirms him as the elder brother of siblings Philip Gottfried (I2877) and Wojciech/Georg (I2739):

"...in the presence of his biological eldest brother Peter Zellmer, who is fifty years old and lives as an innkeeper in the Trąpczyn Haulander under number 21, and his biological youngest brother George Zellmer, who is forty-two years old and lives as an innkeeper in the Trąpczyn Haulander under number 22..."

While C0512 lists Piotr's age at death to be 78 (making him born in 1753), C0506 lists his age to be 30 in 1808, making him born in 1778. 1778 would be too late of a birth year as his first child was born in 1785, so likely he was older than 30 in 1808.

There is one mention of his wife Dorota Klingspor (I2880) being a godparent to a birth in 1778 (Image 488 of 848, not cited in this database), meaning her estimated date of birth would be at least 15 years earlier (around early 1760s), which lines up with her date of death (at age 70 in 1833, making her born in 1763). However, Piotr is listed as being younger than his wife in C0506 (Piotr age 30, Dorota age 40 in 1808, making her born in 1768), meaning Piotr would have been born in 1778, this year being too late before the birth of his first child as mentioned above. For this reason, C0506 can likely be discounted as too inaccurate to estimate Piotr's date of birth.

At least one other death record for his supposed sibling Wojciech (I2739) was wildly inaccurate and listed an age that was nearly 15 years too old, making it possible that some ages listed in death records of this period are unreliable.

No records for a Piotr Celmer appears in S0066 before 1777, where Piotr is mentioned as a godparent to a birth (Image 277 of 848, not cited in this database), meaning his estimated date of birth would be at least 15 years earlier (around early 1760s), which roughly lines up with his date of death (at age 78 in 1831, making him born in 1753).
